name: Advanced Filesystem: Audio Processor
description: Enterprise audio processing: metadata extraction, waveform PNG, trim, convert, normalize, strip ID3 metadata via FFmpeg.
project_description: Advanced Filesystem: Audio Processor is a submodule of Advanced FileSystem that turns Drupal managed audio files into a processable subsystem backed by FFmpeg and FFprobe. Its AudioProcessorService probes metadata (duration, bitrate, sample rate, channels, codec, ID3/Vorbis tags), renders a waveform PNG via ffmpeg's showwavespic filter, and produces derivatives: trim to a time range, convert between mp3/aac/flac/ogg/wav, EBU R128 two-pass loudness normalization, strip metadata, and split stereo into two mono files. Processing can run automatically on upload via a queue (hook_file_insert + the adfs_audio_process queue) or on demand from per-file admin tabs and a batch form. Jobs and their extracted metadata are stored in adfs_audio_jobs and each derivative in adfs_audio_derivatives, surfaced through a dashboard with disk-usage, cleanup and reprocess actions. It also registers an 'audio_processor' Media source plugin. All routes are gated behind the restricted administer permission.
